title: How to Build a Community Platform with AI (Like Discord, Circle, or Slack)
summary: Build a custom community platform — member profiles, discussion channels, event management, and monetization — with AI in days, not months. Complete guide with Blink.
body_markdown: Custom platforms let you own your member data, build exactly the features your community needs, and choose your monetization model. Circle and Discord constrain your data ownership and customization. A community built on Blink: you own the database, you control the UX, and you're not subject to platform policy changes.
